==English==

===Etymology===
From the {{der|en|nl|-}} surname, probably a variant of {{m|nl|Luik}}, a city in Belgium.

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|s}}

# {{surname|en}}.

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Like'' is the 21878<sup>th</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 1187 individuals. ''Like'' is most common among White (81.3%) individuals.
